title: Cinnamon-Raisin Bagels with Cream Cheese
summary: A firm bread-flour dough with cinnamon and sugar has soaked raisins kneaded in, is shaped into rings, chilled overnight, poached and baked a little cooler so the fruit does not scorch.
equipment: stand mixer with dough hook (or large bowl)
2 baking trays lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

ingredients.note: soaked 10 min in hot water, drained and patted dry
about 1 tbsp; for colour; very little clings to the bagels

ingredients.item: fine cornmeal or semolina, for the tray

steps.title: Soak the raisins
steps.text: Soak the raisins in hot water 10 minutes, drain and pat dry.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Combine the flour, yeast, salt, cinnamon and sugar with the honeyed ice water, knead 8 minutes, then knead in the raisins.

steps.title: Portion
steps.text: Cut into 8 pieces, round into tight balls and rest 15 minutes.

steps.title: Form rings
steps.text: Press a thumb through each ball and stretch into a ring with a 4 cm hole.

steps.title: Poach and bake
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Poach 45 seconds a side, then bake 20-24 minutes until evenly browned. Cool before splitting.

tips: Dry raisins knead in more easily and do not tear the dough.
Tuck any raisins on the surface underneath so they do not burn.
Toast leftovers to bring back the crust.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature and eat within 2 days, or freeze for up to 1 month. Refresh in a hot oven for a few minutes. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
